messages:
Eva: Quick preflight for tomorrow's webinar — can we confirm registration page test, Zoom recording settings, and post-event follow-up automation? Who's owning each piece?
Mike: I can take the registration page. I pushed a test form to the staging page earlier, please try it. Link: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinar-reg
Sophia: I'll own Zoom. Quick checklist: cloud recording ON, record separate audio, enable transcript, make me alternative host, waiting room off for faster entry, verify recording retention.
Ryan: I'll do post-event follow-up. Plan: 1) send recording email within 2 hours, 2) 3-day nurture with top clips, 3) tag attendees vs registrants in HubSpot and pass to SDR queue for qualified opens.
Mike: Reg page notes: include hidden UTM fields for source, campaign; add a radio for timezone and auto-convert in confirmation. Confirmation copy needs the two CTA buttons (watch replay, book demo).
Eva: Confirmation email draft (quick):
```
Subject: Thanks for joining — webinar replay + resources
Hi {{first_name}},
Thanks for attending "Building cost-efficient LLM features". Watch the replay: {{replay_link}}. If you'd like a walkthrough, book time: {{demo_link}}.
Best,
Redwood Team
```
Can someone add CTA buttons in the email template?
Mike: I can wire the buttons. Also set up the Zap: form -> HubSpot contact create/update -> add to webinar list -> send confirmation via SendGrid. I'll post the Zap steps shortly.
zoom-bot: Recording enabled for meeting 987-654-321, cloud recording: true, transcript: true, hosts: Sophia, Eva.
Sophia: Quick note on clips: I'll mark timestamps for 3 highlight clips during the session. Ryan, can you confirm lengths you want? 30s, 90s, 3min?
Ryan: 30s teaser, 90s highlight, 3min mini-demo — perfect. Add captions for social.
Eva: One more ops ask — accessibility: ensure transcript attached to replay and include alt text for slide images in the follow-up email.
Mike: Tested lead routing: HubSpot property mapping attached in the staging doc (see drive link). Also added a hidden field for "company_size" for better segmentation.
Sophia: I'll set Zoom to auto-save chat and include it in the post-event artifacts.
Eva: Sweet. Owners summary: Mike = registration + Zap + email buttons; Sophia = Zoom + recordings + clips; Ryan = follow-up cadence + tagging + SDR handoff; Eva = overall ops + accessibility checks.
Ryan: Sounds good. I'll draft the 2-hour recording email by EOD and share for review. :thumbsup:
Mike: I'll finalize the confirmation email buttons and publish reg page at 10:30am PT.
Sophia: Zoom settings locked and test meeting recorded successfully at 14:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
Eva: Thanks team — last check tomorrow at 09:30 PT in #marketing. Ping me if anything breaks. :pray:
